description.summary: The caster emulates a nakk’s ability to enhance herself or an ally with magical strength
description.value: The caster emulates a nakk’s ability to enhance herself or an ally with magical strength. Magic fang gives one natural weapon or unarmed strike of the subject a +1 enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls. The spell can affect a slam attack, fist, bite, or other natural weapon. The spell does not change an unarmed strike’s damage from nonlethal damage to lethal damage. Learned From Mesmanir, Nakk and Unicorn Greater Bestial Fang School enhancing; Level blue mage 3 CASTING Casting Time 1 standard action EFFECT Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels) Target one living creature Duration 1 hour/level (D) Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless) DESCRIPTION The caster emulates a black nakk’s ability to enhance herself or an ally with great magical strength. This spell functions like bestial fang , except that the enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls is +1 per four caster levels (maximum +5). This bonus does not allow a natural weapon or unarmed strike to bypass damage reduction aside from magic. Alternatively, you may imbue all of the creature’s natural weapons with a +1 enhancement bonus (regardless of your caster level). Learned From Black Nakk, White Nakk, and Unicorn Family.
